I burn my decency for someone else's future. I burn my life to make a sunrise that I know I'll never see. And the ego that started this fight will never have a mirror or an audience or the light of gratitude. So what do I sacrifice? Everything!|Luthen Rael|audio=LuthenSacrifice-OneWayOut.mp3|{{Andor|One Way Out}}}} '''Luthen Rael''' was the name adopted by '''Lear''', a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[spymaster]] who led a [[Axis network|covert network]] during the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Lear was originally an [[Imperial Army trooper]] [[sergeant]] forced to commit [[Unidentified massacre (Luthen Rael)|atrocities]] before he deserted in around [[18 BBY]], in the process rescuing a young war orphan whom he named [[Kleya Marki]]. A decade later, he had become an [[Antiques dealer|antique dealer]] who owned [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest]] on the [[The galaxy|galactic]] [[capital]] of [[Coruscant]], though the gallery was a front for his [[spy]] network. Alongside Marki, Rael secretly collaborated with others figures, such as [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] and [[Partisans|militant]] [[Saw Gerrera]] to oppose the Empire. By [[5 BBY]], Rael had built a network of many operatives and had tasked the rebel [[Vel Sartha]] with leading an [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|infiltration team]] to [[Aldhani heist|rob]] the [[Aldhani Garrison|Imperial garrison]] on the planet [[Aldhani]], where the quarterly payroll for an entire [[sector]] was being kept. [[Standard day|Days]] before the operation, Rael received word from a contact on the planet [[Ferrix]] and traveled to meet them. There, Rael recruited the human [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], rescuing him from [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] security forces. Rael then sent Andor to join the Aldhani team. The operation was successful, and Rael celebrated the victory back on Coruscant. Following the conflict on Ferrix, [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]] became interested in the mystery individual who had aided Andor, identifying them as a rebel leader responsible for the theft of several pieces of valuable Imperial technology across the galaxy. Code-named "'''Axis'''" by the ISB, Rael became a high-priority target for Meero. Rael continued his operations, attempting to work with various scattered rebel groups across the galaxy, including [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]] and another [[Anto Kreegyr's group|group]] helmed by [[Anto Kreegyr]]. The rebel leader attempted to recruit Gerrera to support Kreegyr's [[Spellhaus attack|attack]] on the [[Spellhaus Imperial power station]] but eventually learned from his secret mole inside the ISB, [[Lonni Jung]], that the Empire had learned of Kreegyr's plan and had set a trap for his forces. However, rather than save Kreegyr's men and raise suspicion of Jung's secret allegiance, Rael decided to sacrifice Kreegyr's group and preserve Jung's safety inside the ISB. In the wake of Andor's disappearance upon completion of the Aldhani heist, Rael had Sartha and her partner [[Cinta Kaz]] track him down. When Andor returned to Ferrix for the [[Maarva's funeral procession|funeral]] of his mother [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva]], Rael traveled there as well. After an [[Ferrix Riot|uprising]] began, fueled by passionate posthumous remarks from Maarva, Andor followed Rael to his ship and pledged himself to the rebellion. After Mothma established the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on [[Yavin 4]], Rael was left alone on Coruscant. When Meero finally [[Raid on the Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest|tracked]] him down in [[1 BBY]], Rael attempted to commit suicide rather than be captured. Despite Imperial authorities medically stabilizing Rael for future interrogation, Marki eventually [[Infiltration of Lina Soh Hospital|assisted]] in allowing his [[death]]. In the end, Luthen Rael would not live to see the culmination of his life's work as he himself correctly believed. Nevertheless, the rebellion Rael helped to create ultimately proved to be a success when the Empire that he despised so passionately was [[Battle of Endor|eventually]] [[Battle of Jakku|defeated]]. ==Biography== ===Early life=== ====Imperial service==== {{Quote|Make it stop!|Lear|}} [[File:Young-Luthen.png|thumb|right|300px|Lear, Imperial sergeant]] Lear from [[Fondor]], a [[Planet|world]]{{Databank|fondor|Fondor}} in the [[Colonies]] region of [[the galaxy]].[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] Following the [[Proclamation of the New Order|dawn]] of the [[Galactic Empire|First Galactic Empire]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' Fondor would become home to many Imperial-loyal citizens, with Lear himself joining the [[Imperial Army]] as a [[Imperial Army trooper|trooper]] and arising to the rank of [[sergeant]] in time.{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-interview-stellan-skarsgard-elizabeth-dulau|text=Andor's Stellan Skarsgård and Elizabeth Dulau Break Down Luthen and Kleya}} states that [[Kleya Marki]] and Luthen Rael had known each other for 17 [[Standard year|years]] by the events of "[[Who Else Knows?]]" The episode occurs directly after "[[Make It Stop]]," which dates itself to [[1 BBY]]. Therefore, Kleya and Luthen met around the year [[18 BBY]]. Lear's service took him to a [[Unidentified planet (Luthen Rael)|planet]] where he served as a [[swamp trooper]] and was ordered to carry out a [[Unidentified massacre (Luthen Rael)|massacre]]. Experiencing a crisis of conscience during the operation, Lear retreated to his detachment's [[starship]], aboard which he discovered a survivor—a young girl who later took on the name [[Kleya Marki]]—stowing away.{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}} ====Beginning the fight==== {{Quote|I wake up every day to an equation I wrote 15 years ago from which there's only one conclusion, I'm damned for what I do.|Luthen Rael|}} [[File:LuthenRael-CGSWG.png|thumb|left|200px|Luthen Rael was an organizer and leader during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.]] Lear—taking on the name "Luthen Rael" At one point between 18 BBY and [[15 BBY]]"[[Coruscant: Whispers of Rebellion]]" states the [[Axis network]] was founded a decade before the events of ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' [[Andor Season 1|Season 1]], which takes place in [[5 BBY]] per the reasoning [[:Template:AndorDate|here]]. they planned one of their first [[Bombing on Naboo|attacks]] against the Empire on the planet [[Naboo]]. Disguised amongst restaurant-goers overlooking an Imperial [[transport]] convoy atop a bridge, Rael ensured the young Marki understood what she would leave behind as a consequence and explained the importance of being able to make decisions on her own. Marki accused Rael of using her as an excuse to potentially back out, but Rael insisted he only wanted to ensure her safety. When Marki was adamant about opposing the Empire, Rael handed her the [[detonator]] and told her to detonate the explosives planted on the transports. Marki hesitated, but when she reached for the switch. Rael stopped her at the last second and pressed it himself. As terrified civilians screamed and fled the restaurant, Rael declared that they had made their choice, and the two stood to leave. In 15 BBY, Rael started laying the foundations for a counter-Imperial movement. Rael would eventually conclude that his fight would condemn him to a joyless life but resolved to nevertheless continue it. All the same, everyday he was faced with his decision and the weight of his actions. By [[5 BBY]],{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} Rael had managed to form and run an extensive [[Axis network|spy operation]] with Marki, who became a dedicated rebel working for him as his second-in-command.{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/9rcqp87xgvc64ts3kgchk48|text=ANDOR S2 Production Brief FINAL 2 4-10-25|date=2025-04-10}} In that capacity, she worked as an emissary, messenger, and enforcer for the cause and found herself without time to rest. As a cover for his rebel activity, Rael had established himself as an antiques dealer and operated the [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest]] gallery on the upper levels''[[Star Wars 100 Objects]]'' of the [[The galaxy|galactic]] [[capital]] of [[Coruscant]],{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} of which Marki was the concierge. In that capacity, Rael forged connections with the galactic elite, which helped to maintain his cover and gave him access to Imperial loyalists.{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} He became a prominent figure in the upper [[Coruscanti]] antiques circle. Several years before 5 BBY, Rael recruited up-and-coming [[Imperial Security Bureau]] employee [[Lonni Jung]] to his cause and took an oath of loyalty with him. By 5 BBY, Jung had been promoted to [[ISB Supervisor]] and was providing Rael with intel from the [[ISB Board]]. The rebel leader worked closely with [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]], who was providing him with a supply of one hundred thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] every [[Standard month|month]], pulled from her [[Mothma family|family]] funds. Rael also worked with [[Partisans|Partisan]] leader [[Saw Gerrera]] whom he supplied with weapons and gear, as well as [[Ferrix]]-based [[Bix Caleen]] who was providing him with stolen tech from Ferrix's scrapyards. Rael kept tabs on forming rebel groups around [[the galaxy]], including [[Neo-Separatist Coalition]] leader [[Anto Kreegyr]], whom Rael observed, at some point, from within the same room without Kreegyr's knowledge. ===Meeting Andor=== {{Quote|These days will end, Cassian Andor. The way they laugh. The way they push through a crowd. The sound of that voice telling you to stop, to go, to move. Telling you to die. Rings in the ear, doesn't it? But they'll think about us soon enough. Soon enough, they'll have something else to listen to.|Luthen Rael to Cassian Andor|{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}}}} [[File:BixLuthen-Andor3.png|thumb|right|300px|Rael speaks with Caleen on Ferrix]] That [[Standard year|year]], upon being contacted by [[Bix Caleen]] of the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]]'s [[Caleen Salyard]] about the sale of an [[Imperial N-S9 Starpath Unit]] under the possession of [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], Rael traveled to the world with his [[Luthen Rael's Fondor Haulcraft|modified Fondor Haulcraft]] to meet with Andor. During that visit, an agent of the [[Imperial Intelligence]] managed to take a picture of Rael''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' as he was disembarking a [[HFY-3920 shuttle ferry|shuttle ferry]] in [[Ferrix Terminal]]; the picture was later identified as possibly depicting "Axis," although his face was not shown. Andor claimed that he had [[Thief|stolen]] the Starpath unit from the [[Steergard Naval Yard|Imperial naval base]] in [[Steergard]], while Rael revealed that he had come to recruit the man, rather than to pursue the device. During their conversation, the two were [[Ambush on Ferrix|ambushed]] by [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] [[Tac-Corpo|Corpos]] who were pursuing Andor as he had recently [[Death|killed]] two of their number on the world [[Morlana One]]. With the help of an angered and close-knit Ferrix community, Rael and Andor worked together to defeat the [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|Pre-Mor forces]]. Mounting a [[speeder bike]], the two then covertly departed Ferrix aboard the former's [[Starship|ship]]. ===A fledgling rebellion=== {{Quote|Why don't you take this on loan?''"
"''May I?''"
"''If your husband doesn't love it, I'll be glad to take it back. It's a daring choice, but I trust you'll have the courage to turn back if it should be a bit much.|Luthen Rael and Mon Mothma, in a coded discussion at his gallery|}} The two traveled to [[Aldhani]], where Rael offered Andor a job, upon the completion of which he would pay Andor 200,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], providing his [[Kuati Signet]] as a down payment with the expectation of his trinket to be returned after the job was done. Andor was to join a group of rebels on a [[Aldhani heist|mission]] to attack the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Aldhani Garrison]]. Rael successfully persuaded Andor that this was a chance to truly hurt the Empire, with Andor taking on the alias "Clem" for the purposes of the mission. Rael then negotiated with the Aldhani rebel leader [[Vel Sartha]], telling her that "Clem" was critical support for the vulnerable group and that she could use him as a replaceable member. Sartha eventually relented and allowed Clem to join. [[File:LuthenRaelAntiqueShop.png|thumb|left|300px|Rael speaks with Mothma about her plans]] Rael then departed for Coruscant, changing his [[Clothing|attire]] and donning a [[wig]]. In his gallery, Rael met with Senator Mon Mothma, under the guise that she was buying a gift for her [[Perrin Fertha|husband]]. In reality, Mothma was secretly leading anti-Imperial efforts alongside Rael. While Marki kept her [[Exmar Kloris|driver]] preoccupied, Rael took Mothma to the back room to talk privately. Though the Senator assured him that his money was in place, she confided that the Empire was increasing the number of spies on her at both the Senate and the bank, keeping her from pulling funds like she'd normally do. As Rael asserted he needed the money to support his operatives, Mothma admitted that she was going to bring someone else into the rebels' inner circle. Rael advised against this, believing adding a supposed ally was a huge risk, but Mothma stood by it, reminding him that she'd be the first to fall. Rael then concluded their conversation by giving her one of his artifacts on loan for her husband, expecting her to return it. ===Aldhani heist followup=== {{Quote|The Empire has been choking us so slowly, we're starting not to notice. The time has come to force their hand.''"
"''People will suffer.''"
"''That's the plan. You're not angry at me. I'm just saying out loud what you already know. There will be no rules going forward. If you're not willing to risk your conscience, then surrender and be done with it.|Luthen Rael and Mon Mothma, after Aldhani|{{Andor|Announcement}}}} Following the successful completion of the heist on Aldhani, which he learned from a client in his shop, Rael went into the back room to have laugh in private at the mission's success.{{Andor|The Eye}} Later on, Mon Mothma returned to the gallery under the guise of returning the sword he loaned her in order to confront him over the Aldhani incident. Rael shamelessly stated that the heist's true purpose was to provoke an overreaction from Emperor Palpatine so the Empire would crack down harder, even if it meant the people, who have long been blind to the Empire's oppression, would suffer. He forewarned her that if she wasn't willing to risk her conscience, she should abandon the cause. Mothma then ended her visit without purchasing anything. Rael then turned his attention to the matter of Cassian Andor, who had gone into hiding after the heist, and judged him to be a loose end that risked compromising his anonymity. Marki then delivered the orders to Sartha to find and eliminate Andor. Some time later, Marki advised him to sever all remaining loose ends along with Andor, including the frequency connection with Caleen on Ferrix—now occupied by the Galactic Empire. Rael agreed and reluctantly shut down the connection. ===Planning new missions=== {{Quote|The man's an ox! Slow! And stupid!''"
"''And strong.|Saw Gerrera and Luthen Rael talking about Anto Kreegyr|}} Rael departed Coruscant the same day and traveled to [[Segra Milo]] where he met with Saw Gerrera to discuss a new mission. He asked Gerrera to meet with a connection of his, Anto Kreegyr, who had been probing the Imperial power station in [[Spellhaus]] and had found some weak spots which Gerrera's rebels could exploit to destroy it. Gerrera refused to risk the safety of his men for someone he did not know, to which Rael protested that he was trying to make Gerrera join the greater rebel movement and finally start working with others. Gerrera ultimately rejected the offer and Rael left empty handed. ===Imperial Security Bureau mole=== {{Quote|I can't do this anymore. I'm a father now. I had no idea how it would feel.|Jung to Luthen|}} Luthen Rael met with Imperial Security Bureau Supervisor [[Lonni Jung]], secretly a spy for the rebellion, in the lower levels of Coruscant after Jung had requested a meeting using various methods of subtly communicating with Rael. At the meeting Jung told Luthen that a new ISB supervisor, [[Dedra Meero]], was rapidly climbing the ranks in the ISB and that she was slowly connecting various attacks against the Empire as part of a galaxy-wide rebellion. In pursuit of Rael, Meero and the ISB had dubbed the man "Axis" due to his theorized centrality to the growing and organized rebellion. They hoped to locate Andor so as to track down Axis. Jung also informed Rael that the ISB had uncovered a planned attack by Kreegyr against Spellhaus. Rael thanked Jung for the information but asked why Jung had requested a meeting. Jung confessed he was planning to leave the ISB and the rebellion, as his newborn daughter had made him reconsider his dangerous high-risk life as a double agent. Rael informed Jung that leaving was impossible, and that Jung's position within the ISB was too valuable to allow him to leave. Jung tearfully confronted Rael, stating that Rael did not actually appreciate Jung's sacrifice for the rebellion and asked Rael what he was sacrificing for the rebellion. After pausing, Rael launched into a monologue about how he had sacrificed everything in his life for the rebellion, shocking Jung into silence. Rael finished by insisting that Jung stay within the ISB as his mole, saying "I need all the heroes I can get." ===Return to Segra Milo=== ====Meeting with Gerrera==== {{Quote|It's your decision, Saw. It's your decision. But know the choice. Do we let Kreegyr go down and play the long game, or do we warn him and throw away a source that's taken years to cultivate?|Luthen Rael, to Saw Gerrera|{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}}}} After declining Jung's resignation, Rael headed to Segra Milo again to warn Saw Gerrera and his Partisans of the trap laid on Spellhaus. By that time, Gerrera had changed his mind and agreed to join Kreegyr in the Spellhaus power station raid, saying that he would bring air support to the raid, only to be met with resistance from Rael. Rael went on to warn Gerrera off, even though he admitted that he did not know what Gerrera would do with the information and that the situation was not ideal for the two. Gerrera went on to challenge Rael on his choice, asking Rael what he would do if he himself took Kreegyr's place. Gerrera then began to suspect that Rael had a source either in Kreegyr's group, the ISB or the Partisans he was determined to protect and pressed for a name. Rael then played on a panicked Gerrera, saying that [[Benthic]] was his informant within the Partisans. Amongst the confusion caused, Rael then pulled out his pistol to make Gerrera pause and listen to him. Rael then explained that if Kreegyr would be sacrificed, the ISB would become ignorant and boastful, whilst if Rael and Gerrera warned Kreegyr, the ISB would begin to become more paranoid. Gerrera was successfully persuaded by Rael, making a difficult choice. ====Encounter with the Empire==== {{Quote|This is Segra-Milo Imperial patrol. Please identify yourself, Haulcraft.''"
"''Sorry, can you repeat back please?''"
"''This is an Imperial patrol. Standby for transponder scan.|Elk and Luthen Rael|}} [[File:Andor-Arrestor.png|thumb|right|250px|An Arrestor cruiser targeted Rael in his Fondor Haulcraft.]] While leaving the planet on his [[V-21.1 Chevlex light haulcraft|Fondor Haulcraft]], Rael had a conversation with Kleya Marki on the current situation regarding the rebellion via transmission, where the two disguised the true meaning of their conversation by making it sound like they were discussing about their own antique shop if their transmissions were intercepted. After Rael implied that Andor could not fall into the wrong hands, the transmission between the two was abruptly cut off by an incoming [[Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser|''Cantwell''-class Arrestor Cruiser]]. The bridge of the Arrestor Cruiser made contact with Rael's Haulcraft, identifying the cruiser as the [[Segra-Milo Imperial patrol]]. After identification was requested by the cruiser, Rael immediately told his [[Fondor Droid Mod|Droid Mod]] to retrieve an active transponder identification, his preference being [[Alderaan]]. Without waiting for the Haulcraft's identification to be scanned, [[Captain]] [[Elk]] of the Arrestor cruiser ordered his crew to activate the tractor beam. Reacting quickly, Rael ordered his Droid Mod to rev the Haulcraft's portside thruster as a decoy burn, buying time for himself to begin activating countermeasures pre-placed on his own ship to fight back against the increasing tractor force emitted from the cruiser. Rael's decoy burn successfully fooled the cruiser into thinking that his engine was overheating, to which the captain of the cruiser ordered the cruiser to prepare a boarding team to board the Haulcraft. The Captain Elk then demanded for Rael to power down his stabilizers, to which Rael responded by saying that he had to manually deactivate his stabilizers, buying yet some more time for the Haulcraft's countermeasures to fully charge. By the time, the fake transponder signal had successfully fooled the crew of the cruiser into thinking that his Haulcraft was indeed from the Alderaan trade alliance, and a crew member asked if the planned boarding was to be cancelled after identification. The captain decided to go on with the plan, stating that it would be good practice for his crew. Rael then suddenly engaged reverse stabilizers, momentarily shocking the crew of the Imperial cruiser. Captain Elk then immediately demanded for the tractor force to increase to Level 5, raising his voice in frustration. Elk then proceeded to give a final warning to Rael to power down or to risk full consequences. Seconds later, the Haulcraft's countermeasures had finished charging. With a flick of a switch, Rael's Haulcraft dispensed bursts of shrapnel from the stern of his ship, taking advantage of the increased tractor force emitted by the cruiser to suck the shrapnel right into the tractor beam generator. The frontal tractor beacon disintegrated and set the Haulcraft free, to Captain Elk's frustration. Elk immediately demanded the cruiser's air wing to be deployed, raising his voice even more. [[File:LuthenRaelsFondorHaulcraftLaserBeams-DaughterOfFerrix.png|thumb|left|300px|Laser beams used by Rael during battle.]] Three [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] and one [[TIE boarding craft]] were deployed into battle, lasers firing. Expertly piloting his Haulcraft, Rael quickly turned his ship, and with an automated targeting system, a retractable laser turret fired two shots, destroying the TIE boarding craft. The laser turret immediately destroyed another TIE fighter. For the remaining two TIE fighters, Rael spun his ship in arcs, activating twin laser beams on the port and starboard side of his Haulcraft, each destroying a remaining TIE fighter. Rael then quickly jumped into hyperspace, leaving the crew of the Imperial cruiser in shock. ===Return to Ferrix=== {{Quote|You came here to kill me, didn't you?''"
"''You don't make it easy.''"
"''I will now.''"
"''What game is this?''"
"''No game. Kill me. Or take me in.|Cassian Andor and Luthen Rael|{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}}}} [[File:LuthenRael-Andor112.png|thumb|right|200px|Luthen Rael returned to Ferrix]] Rael later traveled to Ferrix once more after hearing that the funeral of Cassian Andor's mother [[Maarva Carassi Andor]] would be held. He hoped that Cassian Andor would attend the funeral, so that he could find him, kill him, and prevent him from spilling his secrets to the ISB. He met up with Sartha there, who informed him that there had been no sign of Andor, but that the ISB were looking for him. Rael expressed his hope that the ISB would locate Andor, allowing them to kill him when they had the chance. Rael hid amongst the crowds of Ferrix on [[Rix Road]] while Maarva Andor's funeral began, still hoping to spot Andor. Unbeknownst to him, Andor had spotted him in the crowd first. Rael then bore witness as the funeral procession ended with the droid [[B2EMO]] presenting a hologram recording of Maarva that she had made before her death, in which she urged the people of Ferrix to not ignore the evil around them any longer and to rise up and fight the Empire. Rael then watched as the message inspired the people of Ferrix to start an all out [[Ferrix Riot|riot]] against the Imperial forces on the road and on the planet. Rael left after the riot began and returned to his ship, slightly rattled. He then discovered Cassian Andor waiting for him in the ship. Andor accused Rael of coming to Ferrix to kill him, which Rael admitted. Andor gave Rael his [[MW-20 Bryar pistol]] and told him to either shoot and kill him or allow him to join his efforts. After picking up the blaster and thinking, Rael discarded the blaster and chuckled. Rael succeeded in recruiting Andor for the then-informal{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}} [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. ===Wedding drama=== [[File:Luthen-Mothma-Chandrila.png|thumb|left|260px|Mon questions Luthen on his motives upon arrival at the wedding.]] In [[4 BBY]], Rael attended the [[wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma]] after he had been contacted by Stekan's father [[Davo Sculdun]] about providing a [[Chandi Merle]] artifact for the couple as a gift. Rael worked with Sculdun to deliver the artifact and keep it as a surprise, arriving at the [[Mothma Estate]] on Chandrila for the event alongside Marki. Mothma was concerned to see Rael in attendance, but Rael insisted that he was working with Sculdun in a curating capacity.{{Andor|One Year Later}} As the three-day wedding went on, Mothma spoke with Rael one evening about how her friend [[Tay Kolma]], who had been helping her with the [[Chandrilan charitable outreach program|charity foundation]] used as a disguise to move money for the rebellion, was beginning to have doubts about his role in helping her. Rael and Mothma agreed that Kolma was growing into a serious problem.{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} On the final day of the wedding, Kolma attempted to leave the festivities early, and Rael sent one of his agents, [[Cinta Kaz]], after him. Posing as his driver, Kaz had Kolma killed to eliminate the security risk he posed.{{Andor|Harvest}} ===Ghorman interest=== {{Quote|You're thinking small, you're thinking like a thief.''"
"''I'm thinking like a soldier!''"
"''Think like a leader.|Luthen Rael and Cassian Andor|}} By [[3 BBY]], Rael had moved Andor and his partner Bix Caleen into a [[Axis network safehouse|safehouse]] on Coruscant. Some time afterwards, he met with Jung in the Undercity for inquire about his three months of silence. Jung told him that he just confirmed that Dedra Meero was secretly running [[Ghorman]] while her colleagues were led to believe she'd been put out to pasture since the incident on Ferrix. This information confused Rael, given Meero's talents as a hunter, nor why the Empire was [[Suppression of Ghorman|choking]] Ghorman with propaganda, and ordered Jung to find out the Empire's endgame. Rael then signaled Andor with a beacon visible from the safehouse for a meeting and ordered him to Ghorman to assess the local rebel group known as the [[Ghorman Front]]. Meanwhile, he sent Andor's friend [[Wilmon Paak]] to the Partisan [[Resistance base|base]] on the planet [[D'Qar]] to help Gerrera's forces.{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}} Rael received updates from Marki about Andor's mission via the fractal radio. With Andor gone, Rael visited Caleen, who he had prohibited from joining Andor on the Ghorman trip, to check on her mental and physical state. When he discovered Caleen was self-medicating with [[sleeping drops]] to cope with her trauma, Rael warned her that her methodology was not the answer to her problems.{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} Upon his return to the gallery, Rael was informed by Marki that she overheard [[Davo Sculdun]] through their listening device hidden in the [[Tinian Codex]], having discovered [[Coryio Chalice|one of his antiques]] is a forgery and that he was planning to re-examine his whole collection, thus risking the discovery of their bug. They soon got into an argument, as Rael blamed Marki for talking him into installing the device in the first place, and that they had too many radios, frequencies and messages to keep track of. Marki put an end to the argument and insisted they remove their listening device at the [[Senate Investiture]]. On Ghorman, Andor spoke with Ghorman Front leader, [[Carro Rylanz]], and soon after, met Rael at [[Port Steergard]] to communicate that the rebels were not ready to successfully combat the Empire. Although Rael shared Andor's perspective on the Front's shortcomings, he nonetheless felt that Ghorman was an important planet to be in rebellion, saying that such a wealthy and significant planet would do wonders for their efforts. As Andor refused to involve himself, Rael pivoted his plans. Contacting Marki, he cryptically informed her of Andor's unwillingness and, using a disguised turn of phrase, requested a second "shipment" for their needs. Sartha and Kaz were soon deployed to assist the Front in their operations. The night following Andor's return to Coruscant, Rael was unexpectedly confronted at his gallery by Andor, who had learned of his meeting with Caleen. Withstanding Andor's anger, Rael told him the cover story he would use when he departed was that he was retrieving a [[Darvian Medallion]], before admitting that how both Andor and Caleen had disappointed him. He then mocked Andor for not being committed to the rebel cause, reminding him of how soft he was on Ghorman as well as being overprotective of Caleen, who needed to pull herself together or become a liability. Andor retorted that their relationship is best handled with Caleen left out of it, before departing. ===Senate Investiture=== [[File:StrangLaughing-WhatAFestiveEvening.png|thumb|260x260px|Luthen Rael spoke to guests after Lonni and Kleya removed the bug]] The next night, Rael, accompanied by Marki, attended [[Davo Sculdun's party]] in honor of the year's [[Senate Investiture]]. While mingling among the guests, Rael allowed [[Strang]] to examine his ring, whom identified it as [[Carvian]]. He then spotted Senator Mothma and spoke with her privately, with Mothma inquiring about the status of her cousin Sartha. Subsequently, Perrin Fertha and [[Runai Sculdun]] summoned them both to join their private tour of [[Davo Sculdun's gallery|Sculdun's collection]]. They walked in as Sculdun was showing off the [[Lost Tairn]] that Rael procured for him to [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] as well as ISB Supervisors [[Lagret]] and [[Avril Heert]]. While Mothma verbally sparred with Krennic on the [[Battle of Carmeen]], Rael cautiously eyed Marki, who had solicited Jung's aid in removing their listening device. Fortunately, Marki was able to remove the device before the rest of the group came to observe the Tinian Codex. Later, as they departed the party triumphantly, Rael dryly remarked that they should have killed Krennic when they had the chance. ===Ghorman burns brightly=== {{Quote|Think about a planet like Ghorman in rebellion. A planet of wealth and status.''"
"''And if it goes up in flames?''"
"''It will burn… very brightly.|Luthen Rael and Cassian Andor|}} By [[2 BBY]], Andor, Caleen and Sartha all left the Axis network to join the growing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Andor ultimately decided to take the assignment, after meeting with Luthen himself.{{Andor|Messenger}} Unfortunately, the chaos of the [[Ghorman Massacre]] thwarted Andor's attempts to kill her, resulting in the mission's failure.{{Andor|Who Are You?}} Knowing that Senator Mothma planned to publicly denounce Emperor Palpatine for the massacre and that [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] had a team ready to extract her from the Senate, Rael confronted her at the [[Imperial Plaza]]. He warned her that Organa's team was compromised, as one of them was an ISB agent serving under Lonni Jung, though he didn't know their identity. Mothma assumed he was trying to manipulate her into trusting only him because he was afraid of what she would say if she got arrested. She then brought up Tay Kolma, whom Rael had immediately eliminated because of the risk he posed. Rael asserted she had to trust his agent, who would identify himself with the code phrase, "I have friends everywhere."{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} This meeting was the final time that the two would encounter.{{InsiderCite|233|The Legacy of Luthen Rael and Mon Mothma}} The next morning, Rael met both Marki and Andor by the Senate loading dock. He remarked that how unsure he was that Andor would take the mission before inquiring the status of Paak, whom Andor said had [[Dreena|someone he needed to find]] on Ghorman. Marki then interrupted to ask what their plan was. Rael admitted that it was a mistake to tell Mothma about Semaj, leaving him uncertain whether or not she was going ahead with her speech. As Marki went to speak with Semaj, Rael told Andor that Mothma would be going to Yavin but he himself was going to stay to resolve unfinished business on Coruscant, despite the risk of the Empire finding him. As Andor's own resolve in the rebel cause was shaken, Rael reminded that he was there for many critical events, from Aldhani to Ghorman. Marki then returned to inform them that Mothma had dismissed Semaj from her service, leaving Andor no choice but to go in blind. After Mothma made her speech and denounced the Emperor for the Ghorman Massacre before the ISB shut off the broadcast, Andor made contact and identified himself with the phrase Rael passed onto her. Soon enough, Rael's warning came true, as Jung's agent, [[Beska]], identified herself as ISB, and tried to arrest Mothma, but Semaj helped Andor kill her. As the Senate Building went into lockdown, Marki ordered Rael to head to the gallery while she tried to find the others. Once Mothma was safely in the Axis safehouse, the Alliance leadership planned for [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] to retrieve her from Coruscant to escort to Yavin to rewrite the story. As Paak had arrived at the safehouse with an injured leg, Rael had Marki tell Andor he had arranged a doctor for him. ===End of the line=== {{Quote|The building is surrounded. You're finished.''"

There's a whole galaxy out there waiting to disgust you.|Dedra Meero and Luthen Rael|}} [[File:LonniJungkilled-MakeItStop.png|thumb|left|300px|Jung was shot by Rael and left on a park bench in broad daylight]] By [[1 BBY]], upon analyzing classified [[Jedha Working Group]] read-outs, Meero learned that Rael had recruited a Partisan spy who was later was tortured and killed by the Empire. The man's confession under duress gave away the fact that Rael had a Fondor Haulcraft and an antiquities shop, which allowed Meero to identify the [[spymaster]]. Armed with this information, she led a raid to confront Rael at his store on Coruscant. In parallel, Jung made a rare request to meet with Rael. Rael rendezvoused with him in a public space and listened as Jung revealed that he had blown his cover in an attempt to learn significant Imperial secrets in classified ISB files. Although Rael was concerned, Jung revealed that he had indeed learned information of great importance to the Empire, saying that the Empire's Energy Initiative was actually a front for the [[Project Stardust|development]] of a [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|secret weapon]], overseen by [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]]. Jung said that the Imperial takeover of Ghorman was connected to the project and revealed the Imperial [[engineer]] and [[scientist]] [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso]] was also of great significance. He also added that the ISB was close to discovering Rael. Wanting to evacuate his family, Jung was prepared to leave that moment, but Rael chose to kill Jung instead, shooting him with a [[blaster pistol]]. His body was discovered and reported to the ISB soon after. Meeting with Marki, Rael passed on the information that Jung had told him and instructed her to contact the rebellion. Meanwhile, Rael returned to Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest to destroy the [[fractal radio]] and protect all of his rebel contacts. It was then that Meero entered the shop. Returning to his facade of the shopkeeper, Rael spoke with Meero until she presented the Starpath unit from Ferrix and revealed that she had finally figured out who he was. Rael attempted to use a [[Nautolan bleeder]] to commit suicide, stabbing himself in the chest with the blade, but Meero's team quickly [[Raid on the Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest|moved in]], stabilizing Rael and moving him to [[Lina Soh Hospital]] on board of an [[Imperial ambunaut]]. [[File:LuthenRaelDeath-Andor-MakeItStop.png|thumb|300px|Rael died after getting unplugged from the life support machine]] As Rael was kept on the [[Medcenter|hospital's]] 19th floor, Meero locked down the level and planned to interrogate Rael. However, Marki was able to [[Infiltration of Lina Soh Hospital|infiltrate]] the hospital. Planting charges on several Imperial vehicles, Marki entered the premises disguised as a nurse, acquired a hospital uniform, killed several Imperials, and, after setting off the explosives, entered the room with Rael. As he was being kept alive by a machine, Marki disconnected Rael from it. With tears coming down her face, Marki gave Rael a kiss on the forehead as he breathed his last breath. ===Legacy=== ====Alliance reputation==== {{Quote|When I say I know Luthen... I mean I know the good and the bad. I know what was wrong with him. I had a front-row seat on that, and I made my choice two years ago, to join here and be part of this. At the safehouse, Andor told Marki that she was helping keep Rael's legacy alive by delivering the intel to the Alliance. Marki initially refused to join the Alliance forces on Yavin 4, but eventually was taken there nonetheless. When Andor imparted the information to [[Alliance High Command]], many of the members were skeptical of the information due to the fact that Rael was the source of it. Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] responded by saying that Rael stayed on Coruscant for too long and that the rumors that the ISB was onto him made it more believably that he was fed false information. Furthermore, Rael's paranoid nature and inability to collaborate with the Rebel Alliance made him not objective and therefore, the information may not be accurate. Andor was incensed as [[Tynnra Pamlo]] also agreed with Organa, calling Rael a "thorn in their side." Andor angrily asked the rebel leaders if any of them had known Rael and knew how much he had sacrificed to help them. Andor would be dismissed from the meeting with High Command still skeptical about the information, although the information would be quickly verified from [[Tivik|multiple]] [[Bodhi Rook|other]] sources.''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' After the meeting, Andor informed Paak of Rael's death. Then, Andor and Sartha drank [[Revnog]] and made a toast to Rael, honoring their former leader. Sartha then asked Andor if the information he had brought was real, saying that Mothma had sent her to speak with him about it. Andor said that it was true, and although they both acknowledged how Rael had been manipulative and twisted, the Rebellion would not exist without him. ====Lasting influence==== {{Quote|Imperial records make reference to a shadowy organizer known as "Axis" who, they eventually came to believe, was coordinating rebel activities scattered across the galaxy. Despite this there is no substantive record within Rebel Alliance files as to who exactly this figure was and what role they had within the organization. It is only through pulling together material from other sources, such as an abandoned datafile recovered from a camp previously operated by Saw Gerrera, that we can suggest that the real identity of "Axis" may have been a man called "Luthen Rael," but information on him is incredibly sparse. Regardless, if, as the Empire believed, such a figure was operating within the earliest framework of the Rebel Alliance, it took them an awfully long time to realize it.|Beaumont Kin, ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|}} Rael's influence on Mothma may have left{{InsiderCite|217|Return of the Jedi: The End of the Beginning|''Return of the Jedi'': The End of the Beginning}} a lasting{{Film|VI}} impression on the senator. While Mothma had previously been hesitant to engage in a violent rebellion, she eventually came to the decision that active combat was necessary to overthrow the Empire. After the Ghorman Massacre, when Mothma left the Imperial Senate and formed the unified Rebel Alliance in [[2 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Mothma became its [[Commander-in-Chief]] and [[Chancellor (Rebel Alliance)|chancellor]].''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' Through it all, however, Mothma never lost her compassion and mourned the rebels who died under her command. Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor]], Mothma tracked down an [[EX communication droid|EX droid]] before its self-destruct timer went off. During the mission Mothma reflected that, had Rael known, he would have considered the decision to install the timer to be paranoid.{{StoryCite|story=No Contingency|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi}} Despite his death, Luthen's life-long goal would be realized when the Empire was ultimately defeated during the Battle of [[Endor]] and conclusively the [[Battle of Jakku]] by the rebellion''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' Rael was indispensable in creating. Little information about Luthen's network and activities survived the [[Galactic Civil War]], with [[historian]] [[Beaumont Kin]] mentioning him as an enigmatic early rebel spymaster in his [[book]] ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''. Kin was able to recover Rael's name from a single [[Data-tape|datatape]] belonging to the late Saw Gerrera, and a photograph taken in secret by an agent of Imperial Intelligence during Rael's first visit in Ferrix in 5 BBY, though the image would only depict Rael from behind. Rael was also mentioned as a prominent antiques dealer in a [[Unidentified historical book|historical book's]] passage about the sky kyber necklace he had once owned. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Calm. Kindness. Kinship. Love. I've given up all chance at inner peace. I've made my mind a sunless space. I share my dreams with ghosts. I wake up every day to an equation I wrote 15 years ago from which there's only one conclusion, I'm damned for what I do. My anger, my ego, my unwillingness to yield, my eagerness to fight, they've set me on a path from which there is no escape. I yearned to be a savior against injustice without contemplating the cost and by the time I looked down there was no longer any ground beneath my feet.|Luthen Rael|}} [[File:LuthenRael-faceinshadow.png|thumb|left|300px|Luthen Rael lived in the shadows of rebellion, adopting the tactics of his enemies in the name of destroying them.]] Luthen Rael was a [[human]] male with [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s, light skin and blond [[hair]], although he frequently wore a grey wig. The man was skilled at discerning valuable finds and labored to personally traverse the [[galaxy]] for pieces necessary to achieve his goals. He was capable of adopting numerous guises and collected a wide range of exotic tools. Always enigmatic,{{InsiderCite|222|A Certain Point of View}} Rael was very cunning and perceptive as he was able to run the spy network and recruit everyone of any use. He was devoted to the cause of fight against the Empire, though he was aware that he would not see the end of the regime. He was ready to sacrifice and kill allies in order to keep his network intact. Beyond the antiques dealer persona, other identities Rael was known to have used included "Gered Lambo," a buyer from Coruscant born on 7903 *288 *04, "Farien Xel," a [[hydroponics]] professional from [[Hynestia Prime|Hynestia]] born on 7903 *340 *01, and "Erwan Mekk," a professor from [[Bar'leth]] born on 7903 *164 *06.{{Instagram|username=graphicsunion|url=p/DJrGl6Asdxq/?img_index=19|name=Graphics Union UK|date=2025-05-15|archiveurl=https://archive.is/MPRXy}} ==Equipment== {{Quote|Rule number one, never carry anything you don't control.|Rael to Andor, after destroying his comlink|}} As a curator of all manner of exotic tools and ancient artifacts, Luthen’s successful antiquities business made him a wealthy man which he used to finance and establish his intelligence network. His wealth also gave Luthen access to state-of-the-art technology and weapons. Rael [[Pilot|flew]] a cleverly modified [[Luthen Rael's Fondor Haulcraft|Fondor Haulcraft]] outfitted with an onboard droid Mod, and armed with tractor beam countermeasures, a dorsal gun turret, and beam weapons that projected from port and starboard, allowing it to sever through enemy craft on either side. He also kept a collection of various items in his gallery on Coruscant. He wore a [[Kuati Signet]] that had a personal significance as a [[necklace]], and additionally kept a vast array of clothing aboard his ship to allow for a quick change of attire. Rael also carried a rapidly collapsible titanium walking stick''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' and a [[blaster pistol]] which he used to engage Pre-Mor corpos on Ferrix and later kill Jung. ==Behind the scenes== ===Development=== {{Quote|[Luthen Rael] is really tricky.
